title: Context Grammar — Token State Schema
description: JSON Schema for a complete Context Grammar token state. Source of truth for the rule engine input.

physical_state.title: Physical State
physical_state.description: User's current bodily state — posture, mobility, hand availability.

cognitive_load.title: Cognitive Load
cognitive_load.description: Estimated mental bandwidth. Never directly measured — inferred from behavioral signals.

social_exposure.title: Social Exposure
social_exposure.description: Who can currently see or hear the device output.

priority_weight.title: Priority Weight
priority_weight.description: Resolves collisions when multiple demands compete. Two layers: token urgency + Brain tradeoff patterns.

form_factor.title: Form Factor
form_factor.description: Available display surface and input modality.

feasibility.title: Feasibility
feasibility.description: Reality filter — what is actually possible right now (inventory, budget, time, weather).

autonomy_dial.title: Autonomy Dial
autonomy_dial.description: How much autonomous authority the AI has. Per-domain, per-person, temporally-evolving.

disclosure_dial.title: Disclosure Dial
disclosure_dial.description: How much personal data the AI can access. Prerequisite for Autonomy.

x-cross-token-rules.name: Driving safety override
x-cross-token-rules.then: ui_density capped to low; voice-only; no manual interaction

x-cross-token-rules.name: Disclosure-Autonomy logical gate
x-cross-token-rules.rule: autonomy_dial level MUST NOT exceed disclosure_dial ceiling

x-cross-token-rules.name: Cognitive overload protection
x-cross-token-rules.then: max_choices: 1; defer non-critical; suppress standard/low priority

x-cross-token-rules.name: Public privacy cascade
x-cross-token-rules.then: treat disclosure as minimal regardless of setting
